records.title: Harvard College Need-Based Financial Aid (International Students)
records.deadline_display: Financial Aid Application Deadlines: Restrictive Early Action and QuestBridge Match — CSS Profile November 1, FAFSA November 1, IDOC November 1; Regular Decision — CSS Profile February 1, FAFSA February 1, IDOC February 1; Transfer — CSS Profile March 1, FAFSA March 1, IDOC March 1. source.raw_extract: The instructions below are for the 2027-2028 school year. ... Financial Aid Application Deadlines. Restrictive Early Action and QuestBridge Match / Regular Decision / Transfer — CSS Profile: November 1 / February 1 / March 1; FAFSA: November 1 / February 1 / March 1; IDOC: November 1 / February 1 / March 1. ... Our goal is to provide you with a decision about financial aid at the time that you are admitted. For Restrictive Early Action and QuestBridge Match applicants that means an estimate of financial aid in mid-December, and for both Restrictive Early Action and Regular Decision applications, a financial aid decision around April 1. Although we'll accept a late application, we may not be able to get back to you as quickly as we would if your application was submitted along the timeline below.
source.exact_deadline_wording: CSS Profile / FAFSA / IDOC — Restrictive Early Action and QuestBridge Match: November 1; Regular Decision: February 1; Transfer: March 1
source.notes: No single calendar deadline exists for this record, so deadline_date stays null. The live official pages publish a three-column table of round-dependent dates (November 1 for Restrictive Early Action/QuestBridge Match, February 1 for Regular Decision, March 1 for Transfer), repeated for each of CSS Profile, FAFSA and IDOC. Selecting one column would require inferring which admission round an international applicant uses, which the provider does not state on these pages. Harvard's International Applicants page explicitly says 'Our financial aid policies are the same for all applicants, regardless of nationality or citizenship' and 'all applicants follow the same procedures and timelables', i.e. it gives international applicants no separate single aid deadline. IMPORTANT: the string stored in this record's cached deadline_display ('Prospective Students: November 1st, for Restrictive Early Action candidates. February 1st, for Regular Decision candidates. March 1st, for Transfer candidates. Current Students: May 1st.') was NOT found on any live page fetched. The Nov/Feb/Mar figures do appear, but only as the tabular CSS/FAFSA/IDOC grid on the Prospective Students page; the separate 'Current Students: May 1st' claim belongs to the Current Students renewal page ('The deadline to renew your aid is May 1'), which is a different applicant population (enrolled students, not prospective international applicants) and has been rejected as evidence for this record. Cached prior values were not carried forward.

records.title: ANRF Ramanujan Fellowship
records.deadline_display: Selection of Ramanujan Fellows will be made periodically by an empowered Selection Committee specially appointed for the purpose.

source.publisher: Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Government of India
source.raw_extract: #### RAMANUJAN FELLOWSHIP Ramanujan Fellowship is meant for brilliant Indian/Indian Origin scientists and engineers from outside India to take up scientific research positions in India ... METHODOLOGY FOR NOMINATION & SELECTION ... Individual Scientists and Technologists should approach the Institutions of his/her choice for hosting them for the fellowship and forwarding their nominations to ANRF for the fellowship. Selection of Ramanujan Fellows will be made periodically by an empowered Selection Committee specially appointed for the purpose. ... Online Application Procedure: Nominee need to register in ANRF online portal, www.anrfonline.in ... Under Form Submission, choose Scheme: Ramanujan Fellowship, and fill the Ramanujan Fellowship nomination form ...
source.exact_deadline_wording: (no deadline wording is published — the only timing statement is 'Selection of Ramanujan Fellows will be made periodically by an empowered Selection Committee specially appointed for the purpose.')
source.notes: The official ANRF scheme page publishes no application closing date, no month, no window and no explicit statement that nominations are rolling or open year-round. The full online application procedure is described step by step with no time limit attached. The only temporal statement is that selection is made 'periodically' by an empowered Selection Committee, which describes the selection cadence and not a submission deadline. Because the provider never states rolling/annual timing, brief section 6 rules out ROLLING and ANNUAL; UNKNOWN is the correct result. Deliberately NOT written: any inference that nominations are accepted continuously all year, and any assumption about how the periodic selection rounds are timed. The record's cached application_period text ('nominations are submitted year-round ... selections are made periodically') is a prior cached characterisation, not language found on the live page, and was not carried forward as a value.

records.title: UZH Hardship Loan
records.deadline_display: Hardship loans can be applied for a maximum of one time per semester. There are no deadlines for these applications.

source.publisher: University of Zurich, Student Financial Aid Office (SIB UZH)
source.as_of: no cycle stated; current page text (copyright 2023, no dated cycle)
source.raw_extract: ## Hardship loan Hardship loans are available if you are enrolled at the University of Zurich and are in an acute financial emergency without any debt. You can apply for an interest-free hardship loan without any bureaucratic red tape. Applications are usually processed within a few working days. You must be able to plausibly guarantee that **the amount will be paid back within six months**. Short-term loans are intended to bridge financial gaps ... **Maximum amount per application is CHF 6,000** Hardship loans can be applied for a maximum of one time per semester. There are no deadlines for these applications.
source.exact_deadline_wording: There are no deadlines for these applications.
source.notes: Explicit rolling admissions, stated by the provider in plain words on the record's own official_source_url: 'There are no deadlines for these applications.' The only frequency limits are 'a maximum of one time per semester' and 'Repeat applications are only possible every 6 months' — both are repeat-application limits, not deadlines, so per brief section 6 this is ROLLING with a null deadline_date and is never dated. Independently corroborated on the second official UZH SIB page (/en/application_deadlines.html), whose deadline table lists 'Hardship loan — at any time (resubmission possible every 6 months)' and whose hardship section repeats 'You can submit your application at any time via portal. Repeat applications are only possible every 6 months.' The two official pages agree, so this is not CONFLICTING. Distinguishing note for the catalogue: the same deadlines table gives Loans 15 August / 1 November / 1 February / 1 April and Scholarships 15 August / 1 February, so the record's previously cached deadline_display string 'You can submit your application' was borrowed from the hardship/loan text and is not a deadline.
